newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tourism Asset shares top turnover.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tourism Asset shares top turnover.

text.p: Shares in hotel holding company Tourism Asset Holdings Ltd, an offshoot of hotel operator AAPC Ltd, topped the turnover list on Friday with 20.11 million shares or about 13.5 percent of its issued capital.
The bulk of the trade was in two lines specialled through Burdett, Buckeridge and Young.
One line consisted of 10.05 million shares at a price of A$1.05 per share and another of 10.05 million shares at a price of A$1.055 per share.
